summary: REQ-3 is well implemented with a dismissible DataRestorationBanner component added to both Home and VideoGallery pages. REQ-1 and REQ-2 have significant concerns: the backend/main.mo diff shows state variables (videos, photos, comments, videoLikes, etc.) declared with 'let' using Map.empty() — non-stable initializers — which would wipe data on upgrade, exactly the bug being fixed. No evidence of stable keyword usage, preupgrade/postupgrade hooks, or migration.mo changes is visible in the diff.

missing_requirements.requirement: Fix stable variable declarations and upgrade/downgrade hooks in main.mo to correctly preserve video metadata and associated data across canister upgrades.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows state variables (videos, photos, comments, videoLikes, ratings, etc.) declared with 'let' and initialized to Map.empty() — these are not declared as 'stable', meaning they will be wiped on every canister upgrade. No preupgrade/postupgrade hooks are visible in the truncated diff. This does not fix the root cause of data loss.

missing_requirements.requirement: Audit and fix migration.mo upgrade logic to ensure it does not reset or drop videos, photos, comments, likes, ratings, or other stable state when adding razorpayConfig and adSenseConfig fields.
missing_requirements.reason: No migration.mo file is mentioned anywhere in the diff (no added, modified, or removed migration.mo). The audit and fix of migration logic is entirely absent from the changes.
